dataPolicy.note: This packet uses derived summaries and source references only. It does not read or export raw source text.

sourceFoundationRefs.note: Derived CR01 context reading summary only; raw original and redacted text are not exported.
Used only to check the first real-derived packet against the existing health-time L3 evaluation expectations.
L3 PIP and CCA IDs are used as bootstrap pattern candidates, not promoted Axiom doctrine.
FT03 gives the response shape and brakes for observation/inference separation, missing context, counter hypotheses, and cannot-yet-say limits.
The audit is used to keep progress centered on kernel build, grounding, eval, display, and review loop.

evidenceSpans.summary: CR01 derived context reading covers 16 records without raw text export; redacted context type counts include health_time, life_security, sequence_or_choice, support_bridge, and work_time_design.
CR01 core reading keeps C01/C06 active only when health time, work design, life security, support, or sequence are read as interacting freedoms.
L3 PIP-01, PIP-02, and PIP-06 frame health-time signals as workload, recovery, evaluation, income, and handoff questions rather than accommodation lookup.
L3 CCA-22, CCA-23, CCA-24, and CCA-27 require anti-lookup, counter-structure, no support-validity finality, and review-loop separation.
FT03 V1 requires health, treatment, fatigue, rest, and return-to-work issues to be translated into work time, workload, and evaluation questions while preserving observation/inference separation.

The weakness audit identifies the missing typed interaction-hypothesis kernel as the core rebuild target and rejects delivery-layer progress as core progress unless it strengthens kernel build, grounding, eval, display, or review loop.

inheritedFrames.reviewerQuestion: Does CR01 context reading support a grounded provisional kernel without becoming source/support validity?
Which L3 health-time pattern IDs are usable as review units rather than promoted truth?
Does the real-derived kernel preserve FT03 observation/inference/missing-context/counter-hypothesis brakes?
Which public skeleton elements can display this kernel only after Axiom eval and public review?

observationCandidates.text: CR01 derived context reading reports a non-sensitive 16-record health-time/life-security corridor with health_time, life_security, sequence_or_choice, support_bridge, and work_time_design context types; raw originals and source text were not exported.
CR01 core reading says C01/C06 should stay active only when health time, work design, life security, support, or sequence are read as interacting freedoms.
L3 health-time patterns and cross-cutting checks require the kernel to avoid condition-to-accommodation lookup and keep counter-structure, support-validity brakes, and review-loop separation visible.

inferenceCandidate.text: The first real-derived Axiom reading is a health-time/work-time/life-security interaction kernel: health-time signals should be translated into workload rhythm, recovery access, support bridge, evaluation/income, and sequence questions, not into a final accommodation recommendation.

counterHypothesis.text: The primary contact point may be life-security constraint, sequence/choice loss, support-bridge gap, or evaluation/income conflict rather than workload rhythm itself.
wouldChange: missing context would move toward income, contract, treatment timing, support continuity, and return-route questions
implementation actor conditions would require public/institutional and employer review before actionability rises

missingContext.question: Which health-time contact point is actually difficult for the person: fatigue, treatment timing, recovery, uncertainty, income pressure, or return route?
missingContext.whyItMatters: The derived corridor cannot be turned into a person-trait or capacity explanation without the person-defined contact point.

missingContext.question: Which workload rhythm, meeting density, task handoff, deadline, or role expectation creates the health-time contact point?
missingContext.whyItMatters: Health-time only becomes work-design knowledge when the concrete job condition is visible.

missingContext.question: Which workplace environment, tools, meeting format, rest access, commute, or informal rule changes the health-time burden?
missingContext.whyItMatters: The same health-time signal can mean physical access, information load, rest-place absence, or social participation pressure.

missingContext.question: Who can translate health, life-security, support-bridge, and work-time information into shared work-condition questions?
missingContext.whyItMatters: Support cannot be treated as valid merely because it exists; the translation function must be visible.

missingContext.question: What sequence matters: treatment, recovery, work start/end, income pressure, return route, review timing, or future change?
missingContext.whyItMatters: CR01 explicitly treats health time and life security as sequence and freedom issues, not static traits.

missingContext.question: Which employer, support, medical, welfare, or public actor can change the relevant time, workload, evaluation, or income constraint?
missingContext.whyItMatters: A provisional kernel is not actionable until implementation authority and institutional constraints are visible.

missingContext.question: Which parts are CR01 derived counts, which are L3/FT03 bootstrap priors, and which would need source/support validity review?
missingContext.whyItMatters: Axiom must not promote derived context reading or bootstrap priors into core truth without review.

missingContext.question: How would respondent, supporter, employer, health actor, public actor, and derived research lenses differ on the same health-time signal?
missingContext.whyItMatters: Source-lens differences are a translation stop point, not noise to average away.

implementationActorConditions.condition: Can name the lived health-time contact point without being forced into diagnosis proof or accommodation menu selection.
Can inspect workload rhythm, rest access, role expectations, evaluation treatment, and income/contract effects.
Can translate health-time, life-security, and support-bridge information into shared work-condition questions while preserving consent and boundaries.
Must decide whether this real-derived packet can remain an internal grounded kernel fixture before any promotion, public copy, or learning update.
